verdict.rationale: Smooth is an AI browser agent, so acting as an MCP client is a fair axis. The evidence never shows it connecting to MCP servers. Its custom-tools feature lets developers register arbitrary functions, and the docs describe that as an alternative to MCP 'without having to deal with servers', which is an adjacent capability rather than MCP-server plug-in support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
